title: An excluded source file never names a module that coverage asks a spec for
description: An excluded source file never names a module that coverage asks a spec for
no_spec_change_rationale: Applies Leif's decision on #613 (orc relay, 2026-11-06: excluded means ignored) and the documented meaning of exclude_patterns (additive source exclusions): the flat-file-stem block now skips an excluded file, as the coverage denominator already did. No requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A flat source file that exclude_patterns excludes names no unspecced module and asks for no spec, while a kept flat file still does (red then green)
